author: ojiudezue
title: v5.103.98 shipped: EC saved-today accrues at mid-peak/peak discharge; cost/hr on effective rate
summary: EC saved-today accrues at mid-peak/peak discharge; cost/hr on effective rate
why: The 11-01 audit found saved-today at 0.01 dollars because the spread mixed a base rate with an effective rate, and it accrued at charge time. The operator chose option A: credit energy when the battery displaces mid-peak and peak import, valued against what that stored energy cost (B2: solar at the export credit given up). Rates must come from the TOU engine so a tariff change flows through without code. Display only; no battery decision input changes.
implications: Shipped EC-COST-AND-FORECAST-MATH-1 at v5.103.98; card(s) sit shipped_organic pending validation. Acceptance in README_v5.103.98.md (Live criteria).
revisit_trigger: Revisit if saved-today after a full mid-peak discharge is outside roughly 0.5 to 2 dollars, if the inventory exceeds SOC times capacity, or when Build 2 (forecast) ships.

refs.release_notes: Saved today now counts battery energy used at mid-peak and peak against the cost of that stored energy (grid at off-peak effective rate, solar at export credit forgone); off-peak discharge earns 0; all rates live from the TOU engine; peak avoidance no longer credits the battery; cost per hour on the effective rate; forecasted import physics fixed.
